notes.title: Closed Alpha Test Update
notes.content:
It is time, massive new update to Chrono Hunter Closed Alpha!

[b]• Adjusted a lot of different feedback, along with user suggestions and more.
• A huge number of new weapons! 
• Introduced 20 new cards in an entire new category called "Fate".
• Reworked and added several challenge stages.
• Introduced new mechanics to the Time Survival Mode; For each enemy defeated, extra time is added. Occasionally, enemies will enter a special state upon death and have unique effects and abilities.
• Added options to disable the UI and switch the player's dominant controlling hand.
• Held weapons no longer disappear when switching stages.
• Reworked the Leveling Up and Characters Skills system to better understand it's use.
• Along with so much more, you will have to see![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225615/2b845e112ccf59d40991b997de24c23f08daa818.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225615/83409b4f47d54c0855de5348839e4f5bfb840f7e.gif[/img]

As always, we remain free and for testing until our game is ready. We encourage everyone to post their feedback in ⁠bugs-and-feedback as we listen closely and are ever so improving our game as each day goes by. 

We thank everyone who participates in this newest version. 

If you would like to participate in this closed alpha, please be sure to head over to our Discord Server and request a key. We've a huge dedicated community filled with many helpful players who are consistently helping us improve the game with suggestions, feedback and more and would love to have everyone's thoughts.

https://discord.gg/v2uPRM8Ffw

notes.title: Take on BOSS CHALLENGE to win AWESOME REWARDS
notes.content:
We are hosting our first ever rewards event, where 5 winners will be sent out promotional material from Chrono Hunter such as unique t-shirts, or novelty collectors items such as Chrono branded gift bags and stickers along with more. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225615/ef677b06994615a1d08fb1f73bab0246738078e2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225615/96b4166b65a9ba7bf852a0bb01038dd5b2757488.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225615/209340e43d789b1f03d805775d1524c0e3c1fe34.png[/img]

We'll keep the rules simple this time:

Successfully finish the final boss in Earth Level 1 in anyway possible, by using any means necessary to achieve the fastest time using whatever gear and abilities you'd like. Then, record a short video and the time will be based on the moment she touches the ground, to the end of the fight.

We will have a channel on our discord server called events where you can share your results. The time limit will be 2 weeks from today.

The top 5 winners will be chosen to receive the rewards, along with a custom role for our Discord Server!

If you need a key to the latest version, please join our discord server and request a key for free!

Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/TpVgXh9HJz
Share your results: https://discord.gg/dnmp8sHKD4

notes.title: Chrono Hunter Brand New Test Build Out Now!
notes.content:
@everyone @Chrono Hunter News @Content Creator 
New test build has launched! Featuring tons of newly added content, mechanics, levels, weapons, enemies and more!

Join our discord server and we'll send you a key to the testing straight away! Links down below!

• Lots of new weapons! Pump-Action Crossbow, Medusa Head, Destabilizer, Gatling Gun & Gatling Laser, and others.
• Enemies now drop proper loot and can be picked up and used by the player.
• Permanent upgrade system for the player using the puzzle-like cube system, think of building blocks. This includes upgrades for the player, weapons and abilities in 3 separate areas. 
• Levels now feature a procedural generation system adding to the variety. Earlier levels have been reworked with more content.
• New areas, traps, and enemies. Expect lots of not-so-cute robots and lots of lava!
• New NPC added to the HUB (working on voice-overs now) and added an AI system to allow early use of them during levels. Some will now fight along-side the player.
• HUB has been reworked to offer much more utility and use.
• Better mission structure and objectives. It is now easier to keep track of scores and information regarding your points.
• New cards and abilities, as well as a reworking of cards with new graphical effects and easier to read UI. 
• Some enemies have been reworked &/or improved. Mages for example are now much more aggressive.

The gameplay, music, sound effects, dialogues, graphics are not yet finalized. We will optimize, adjust and add more content according to your feedback and suggestions!

We hope you enjoy this brand-new version. Be sure to use our FEEDBACK CHANNEL and please, write down all bugs, suggestions or whatever questions you may have here!

JOIN OUR DISCORD AND REQUEST A KEY:
[url=https://discord.gg/QehtRKVyvm]Chrono Hunter Discord[/url]

We thank our Hunters!

notes.title: Traxus Plays Chrono Hunter ALPHA TEST!
notes.content: Welcome to Chrono Hunter! Shift through time and use your powerful clockwork abilities to foil the plots of the malevolent time anomalies! Slay your foes with brute force, dexterous cunning or sheer force of will!

notes.title: Chrono Hunter Alpha Test is Here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225615/6e1326acf41b9b7b2944630cc967f89e1a6a6288.jpg[/img]


Dear Agents,

After months of hard work, we can finally get A-Test version of Chrono Hunter ready for you. Signup begins today! The Alpha Test will be [b][u]starting on Oct 9th[/u][/b] will [b][u]last untill Oct 30th[/u][/b].  

We sincerely invite you to participate in our test. Please click the Request Access button to let us know you want to join in! 

Your feedback is gold to us! [url=https://discord.gg/99DtykzkwK]Join our discord[/url] to lodge your feedback, or simply post your thoughts in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2092670/discussions/]Steam discussion[/url]. 

With this playtesting party, we are aiming to build Chrono to fit our community's preferences. To appreciate your help in making Chrono a better game, [b]we will give out the full copy of the Steam Key of Chrono Hunter to everyone who would provide well-considered feedback (content suggestions, content critics, bug reports, and so on and so forth). [/b]



For this major update we paid more attention to the immersive experience in this version, adding vertical slices of cutscenes, voiced characters, and 2 major NPCs fully motion-captured. Although this is only the test version and not complete in many aspects, we hope to let you all participate in this experience we are thrilled to build on!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225615/e8c7505f7077980e3f9ae21fbca0b49d737e2be2.gif[/img]

We have added a progressive mission system in this version. They will not only integrate the plot and narratives but also provide different mission types and make the gameplay more diverse. Meanwhile, controls and UI have gone through certain optimizations.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225615/1725d7a8374df741174dd61144db7fe22a869060.gif[/img]


In addition to the usual firearm combat, the current mission types also include stealth and melee combat gameplay, and objectives of each mission vary in different ways. Now you can take the weapons dropped by enemies and make better use of them. There is also a new weapon slot that allows you to store the weapons and items you picked up.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225615/f370ef04953e78568593457d4dfcc9d190820f4c.gif[/img]

At present, it is only the first version of various functions and systems. More NPCs will appear in the future, and there will be richer performances and plot animations. Each NPC will have corresponding tasks and a lot of dialogue, and more useful ones will be unlocked: Equipment and skills.

Thank you all for your support, please enjoy the happiness brought by Chrono Hunter!

notes.title: Demo Update (Aug 4th 2023)
notes.content:
Hi Agents,

We got lots of feedback in the past few weeks following the release of Chrono’s demo, we were thrilled to get to know your experience with the game! Thanks to your test plays and feedback, we brought some new features and fixes to this update. Enjoy your adventure and we hope to learn your thoughts and feedback on this update. We read absolutely every single comment, post, and burp in the Steam forum, discord server, and social media comments. 

[url=https://discord.gg/99DtykzkwK]Catch us in our discord and we would love to have you on board for future tests and community giveaways. [/url]

In this new patch, we focused on adding action aspects to the gameplay, optimizing interactive friction, and balancing tweaks. Oh! we also added access in our lobby straight to the boss challenge since everyone enjoyed the boss fight so much. 

The current in-game tutorials are placeholders. We'll invest our time into a fun and fully polished tutorial after the game's fundamentals are all developed. Before that, you can also check these tips for weapon upgrading and handling. 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225615/890cbf1c793d9a370b9e5a48ba103ba3f490057b.jpg]For the pistol CLICK --->[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225615/377ca18fa81b19ee1d4a9ea2469afe85ac9fa7e2.jpg[/img][/url]____[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225615/c7e178ff6503cff3f68bf1a5bba3bff2879aebaa.jpg]For the bow CLICK --->[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225615/896d2c63b16735a2f01d9d0a380b08e8463fc609.jpg[/img][/url]

List of updates:
1. Added more level configuration to better diversify the combat experience.
2. Added Shield Maneuvering, now you can take the shield from the enemy using Gravity Glove and use it to block long-range attacks and melee attacks, and you can use it to stun enemies (throwing it and using it to melee)
3. Added a Boss level shortcut, now you can enter the Boss level directly from the lobby (Those muscles of hers are not just for showboating, beware!)
4. Optimized multiple special effects and handling of interactions.
5. Now there are two control schemes to upgrade your weapons.
6. Optimized tutorial section’s content and process.
7. Optimized weapon upgrade’s UI.
8. Optimized BGM volume so it won’t be too loud in certain stages.
9. Optimized some UI texts with unclear descriptions
10. Fixed the issue of unable to deal weak-point damage when hitting male and female warlocks in the head.
11. Fixed the issue of hitting the warlock's weapon also causing damage to the warlock itself.
12. Fixed the issue of the totem summoned by the warlock did not disappear
13. Fixed the issue of unable to use PULL when in Vive mode.
14. Fixed the issue of unable to turn in Vive mode.
15. Fixed the collision issue in some levels.
16. Buffed the number of uses of the Shield.
17. Buffed the damage of Explosive Arrows.
18. Buffed the damage reduction of AOE damage when holding the Shield.
19. Nerfed the warlock’s HP.
20. Adjusted the difficulties of some levels.

notes.title: Demo Hotfix Update - June 16th
notes.content:
[h3]Fix[/h3]
1. Updated the adaptation for Index, Vive and PICO
2. We tested out the VD streaming and it can work to some extent, we need more testing to guarantee it can run smoothly.
3. Fixed certain issues regarding the pistol and archery training.
4. Fixed certain glitches in the Boss fight
5. Optimized certain numbers and stats to improve gameplay.

[h3]Improvement[/h3]
1. Now you can use your skills by pressing Trigger while in a empty-handed state (removed the original complex button combination)

We are looking forward to more of your feedback!

notes.title: Demo Release Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Agents,

We love to create fun experiences for our players to have great times. Through years VR development experiences, we are ready to land our own title. We have poured our hearts into our latest creation, Chrono Hunter. We strive to bring the VR community the exciting experience with our sincere offering. We hope this endeavor will become a flagship VR title in the realm of VR gaming. 

[h3]Don't Forget to Wishlist It[/h3]
Chrono is coming soon to SteamVR. Wishlist now and join our discord for future updates.
We hope you enjoy the demo and get ready for the ultimate VR shooter experience!

[h3]Highlights of The Demo Gameplay:[/h3]
1. Multiple weapon upgrades and enhancements with various skill combinations
2. Ever-changing level mechanisms and tons of different and unique enemies
3. Challenging yet rewarding Bosses

[h3]Chrono Hunter Demo Content[/h3]
1.Demo’s total playtime lasts for 40-100 minutes depends on player’s level of expertise and dedication to explore.
2.Demo’s replayability lies with trying out different weapon and skill combinations, progression routes and builds
3.Demo features more than 10 types of different enemies and 1 final boss with a total of 4 unique levels and 1 boss stage.

[h3]Future Development[/h3]
1.A fully fleshed out and self-contained story to drive the plot forward.
1.Emphasize on more unique weapons and skills and implement more physics-based playstyle in the game
2.There will be at least more than 30 types of enemies and variants in future updates. At least 4 bosses and a variety of elite enemies each with unique move sets. We are also planned to have a total of more than 30 maps with 3 completely different art styles. There will be an ultimate Roguelike challenge mode
3.We are also interested in the possibility of implementing MOD support and developing co-op mode. After the full game’s been completed, that is.

[h3]We Are Looking Forward to Your Feedback And Bug Report[/h3]
Catch us in person from our discord server or leave a post in our steam forum.
Your suggestions are gold to us!
